title: Blueberry Almond Smoothie
subtitle: Fruit · Berry
description: Blueberries and almond butter give you antioxidants and staying power without a long ingredient list. Mild, crowd-friendly, not “health food” weird.
intro: Blueberries and almond butter give you antioxidants and staying power without a long ingredient list. Mild, crowd-friendly, not “health food” weird.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Blueberry Almond Smoothie in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Blend. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Combine blueberries, almond butter,
steps.instruction: Combine blueberries, almond butter, milk, and yogurt in the blender. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Blend on high until
steps.instruction: Blend on high until the purple color is even and the almond butter is fully incorporated. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add oats and lemon
steps.instruction: Add oats and lemon if using; blend 30 seconds more until smooth. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Should taste nutty and
steps.instruction: Should taste nutty and fruity, not bitter — add a teaspoon of honey only if blueberries were tart. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

substitutions: Peanut butter swaps in if almond butter is not on hand.
Silken tofu (½ cup) can replace part of the yogurt for a dairy-free batch.
shiftNote: Berries hide in the freezer well — good pantry item for halls trying to stock healthier grab-and-go options.
proTips: Berries hide in the freezer well — good pantry item for halls trying to stock healthier grab-and-go options.
Rinse the blender jar between batches so flavors do not muddy the next crew's cups.
If tones drop during service, cover hot food and hold at 140°F — note hold time on the pan for food safety.
tonightSpread: Pour Blueberry Almond Smoothie into insulated cups or quart jars on ice for grab-and-go service.
Set granola, nut butter, and extra fruit in side bowls so crew can customize without slowing the line.
Keep a backup blender batch chilled at 38°F if service runs past 20 minutes.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
